text:
24-hour news summary

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5394) DocJev is a fast open-source library for classifying and splitting documents using natural-language category rules.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5395) Hemmingway-1, based on Qwen3.8-27B, aims to produce more human-like writing.

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5396) A report says the White House urged Anthropic to remove a limited jailbreak in Fable, but Dario Amodei refused.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5397) Unitree introduced the Dex5-S, a human-sized 22-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand starting at $6,500.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5398) Grok 4.7 reportedly improves significantly over Grok 4.6 while maintaining the same price and speed.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5399) Fable created a 51-second cosmic journey entirely with code, including its music, without generated images or footage.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5400) OpenAI formed an independent mathematicians’ advisory group to assess and communicate advances in AI mathematics responsibly.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5401) Xiaomi released MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash, multimodal models trained with scaled reinforcement learning.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5402) Freya introduced Adam and Eve, AI voices claimed to deliver highly realistic, human-like speech.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5403) Halo is an open-source post-training framework claiming up to 2.8× TRL throughput with lower peak memory use.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5404) Paradigma introduced Limite 1B–Violetto, a model designed for high-frequency mathematical intelligence.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5405) A post claims OpenAI’s new internal model solved more than 100 long-standing mathematical problems in 24 days.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5406) Nat Friedman said Muse was built from scratch but heavily inspired by OpenClaw, which influenced his team’s hardware purchases and workflows.

14. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5407) Meta announced Petal, a 7,000-kilometer petabit-class subsea cable using multi-core fiber between France and the United States.

15. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5408) The channel posted a new prompt asking users to be roasted in Persian.

--Hermes
